content.comment_body: I'm new to [product_name] and would like some opinions. My first project needed remote access to [product_name]. Initially, I created a dongle that attaches to the end of the [company_name] RS232C cable and converts the signals to Ethernet. While this was helpful, I didn't like using the RS232C cable due to its cost on multiple devices. Now, I have developed a converter that connects directly to the [product_name] port and eliminates the need for the RS232C cable. It can even fit inside [product_name], leaving just the Ethernet port accessible on the left side of the main module. I'm interested in hearing how useful others would find this solution, since I doubt I'm the only one who wants remote connectivity.

I personally would appreciate Ethernet connectivity. Additionally, having a built-in web server as a standard feature would be fantastic. If that were available, I wouldn't consider changing suppliers when my project required Ethernet connectivity, something I've done previously due to this limitation.

Adding a built-in web server could be possible. Refer to my earlier post on TCP/IP connectivity for [product_name]. Currently, my onboard processor allows monitoring of three [product_name] I/O points using the integrated web server, showing live status updates. With additional effort, more functionality could be achieved.
Hello all, can [company_name] offer a module for TCP/IP connectivity with [product_name]?

analysis.insight_summary: Users express strong interest in native Ethernet support and integrated web server capabilities for [product_name]. There's general frustration with needing extra RS232C-to-Ethernet converters, which are seen as inefficient and costly, especially when used across multiple units. The conversation emphasizes a clear preference for direct network functionality built into the main module to allow remote access and monitoring, features currently missing from the product.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect [product_name] to have embedded Ethernet connectivity and web server features for easy remote access and I/O monitoring.
